representation: A: direct transcription of primary text, full A B R S tensor and A R reduction
source: arXiv:2608.28897v1, p.2 Theorem 1 Eqs.(2)-(10), p.7 Appendix A Eqs.(A1)-(A10)
domain: All xij are real nonnegative; x00**2+x01**2+x10**2+x11**2=1. Zero entries are allowed.
spectrum: lambda_plus/minus=(1 plus/minus sqrt(1-4*(x00*x11-x01*x10)**2))/2; two further zeros in AR
arbitrary_purification: T[i,j,r,s]=xij*phi_ij[r,s], with phi_ij orthonormal on the occupied support
appendix_a: For normalized X in AR and Y in BS, define a_i=norm(X_i), b_j=norm(Y_j). Then abs(<X,Y|Psi>) <= sum_ij xij*a_i*b_j <= norm_2(M)=sqrt(lambda_plus). Thus q1<=lambda_plus.
entropy_convention: Base 2; q are squared singular values; 0 log2 0=0.
